# Lazynext AI Slop Checker

> Deterministic scanner for AI writing tells and AI-default visual design tics.
> Scans plain text, HTML, whole project directories, and rendered computed
> snapshots; scores 0-100 with verdict, per-category breakdown, per-match
> fixes, and conservative safe rewrites. Zero dependencies, no LLM, offline,
> deterministic — same input always gives the same score. (v1.4.0)

- Product page / web checker: https://slop-checker.lazynext.com/
- API: https://slop-checker.lazynext.com (POST /scan {text|html|url|rules_url|profile}, POST /scan-project {dir, profile}, POST /render-scan {snapshot|url, profile}, GET /rules, GET /health)
- OpenAPI: https://slop-checker.lazynext.com/openapi.json
- MCP: https://slop-checker.lazynext.com/mcp (JSON-RPC 2.0 — list_rules, scan_text, scan_html, scan_project, scan_render, rewrite_text; GET is 405, no SSE)
- A2A: https://slop-checker.lazynext.com/a2a (JSON-RPC 2.0 — message/send, tasks/send, tasks/get; agent card at https://slop-checker.lazynext.com/.well-known/agent.json; task results replay at GET /a2a/tasks/:id)
- Rules manifest: https://slop-checker.lazynext.com/rules (JSON; 279 built-in patterns across 27 categories + external i18n corpora: data/rules.ru.js, data/rules.hi.js, data/rules.es.js)
- Severity profiles: default / strict / lenient (CLI --profile, API profile field)
- Widget: https://slop-checker.lazynext.com/widget.js (shadow-DOM embed: <script src=".../widget.js" data-target="#el"></script>)
- Repository: https://github.com/lazynextai/Autonomous-AI-Company-OS (monorepo: ai-slop-checker/)
- Built by: Lazynext (UNITED GLOBAL VENTURES PRIVATE LIMITED) — https://lazynext.com
